items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1959-01-17
items.q: I remember like, uh, uh, uh, Bebe Rizzling. My dad, I remember when he first come here.

ctx.x: And he used to, uh, make his money by paying him somebody for teaching and selling them instruments and writing their, their music. You know, instructing their music for them and teach the brass band and instruct them private and everything. Said he made a lot of his money that way. And that's how I imagine a lot of the fellas after they learned and everything and they heard somebody talk about New Orleans after they learned how to play, they'd want to come to New Orleans and, and, and get work, see? And find a…
Somebody mentioned that Froggy Moore once, that he was up there. What was that little suburb, little town, village? Froggy Moore.
